data.body: Gerrit PS7 advisory is genuine and FIXED RED-FIRST. The workflow canary counted binding_drift.dangling as alerting while bridge fsck intentionally treats it as informational, so a confirmed 404 candidate could make the canary disagree with CLI exit semantics. Strengthened the held-out canary contract: dangling-only must produce drift_found=false, drift_total=0, drift_summary=none, and mixed summaries omit dangling. RED was 2/2 with the prior tuple; after removing dangling from _DRIFT_CELLS, the combined canary/fsck/library/MCP focused suite is GREEN (104 passed). This preserves checked-out workflow behavior while aligning automation with the canonical alerting contract.
